Born and raised in the beautiful town of Camp Phillips, Bukidnon, Hesso is an operations specialist with a degree in Business Administration from Misamis Oriental Institute of Science and Technology, specializing in Marketing Management. His professional path includes a decade-long tenure at JPMorgan Chase & Co., where he excelled as an Account Specialist and Peer Coach, driving high-volume financial data verification, ledger auditing, and complex account reconciliation.

Outside of his work in operations, Hesso is an outdoor enthusiast who loves spending quality time in nature. You can often find him going on enduro mountain bike adventures, trail biking, and exploring the scenic mountains of Bukidnon through family camping trips and riding trails with his two boys.
